title: Ukrainian Egg Frittata
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring eggs, dry cured meats, and vegetables, this frittata is a hearty and satisfying meal. It is paleo-friendly and features a malty, crunchy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the diced salted pork fat over medium heat until crispy.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, dried dill, black pepper, and sea salt.
Add the cooked mushroom and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake the frittata in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
